 Match Preview
 Premier League - Game Week 11 21 Nov 2026 - 09:00 Vitality Stadium AFC Bournemouth host Nottingham Forest at the Vitality Stadium in a Premier League fixture that pits one of the division's most in-form sides against a team desperate to arrest a damaging run of poor results.
 Marco Rose's Bournemouth have been one of the stories of the season. Five wins from five across all competitions, including victories over Manchester United, Aston Villa in the Carabao Cup, and Sparta Prague in the Europa League, mark the Cherries out as genuine top-half contenders with ambitions that stretch well beyond mid-table comfort.
 Nottingham Forest arrive at the Vitality Stadium under pressure. Oliver Glasner's side lost three consecutive Premier League games before beating Manchester City 3-1 last time out, a result that offered encouragement but does little to mask an inconsistent campaign so far.
 Bournemouth's attacking output has been particularly sharp. They have scored nine Premier League goals in their last three top-flight outings, with Evanilson leading the line as part of a fluid front unit that has caused problems for every side they have faced.
 Forest, sitting 16th in the table, know that another defeat here would deepen their concerns. Liam Delap and Morgan Gibbs-White will need to be at their best if Glasner's men are to take anything from a ground where the home side have been formidable.
 Bournemouth also have European football to contend with this week, hosting Viktoria Plzen in the Europa League on December 10, which adds a layer of squad management complexity for Rose ahead of this contest.
